maTafdc.message: Massachusetts TAFDC uses the state's ONGOING-RECIPIENT rules ($200/month per earner, then a 50% disregard) in place of PolicyEngine's formula; PolicyEngine recomputed SNAP and every other linked benefit with the corrected grant. This is the steady state, not the first year: TAFDC disregards all earnings for six months before the 50% rule starts, so DTA's published examples (its FY2026 report shows $7,512 at $15,600 of earnings for a family of three, where this gives $4,212) are year-one figures and are higher on purpose. New-applicant eligibility is not modeled.
